The large cyan handles are the hands, feet, and pelvis: drag a hand or foot and the elbow or knee bends by itself; if it is out of reach, the body follows. The yellow diamonds show which way the elbows and knees point. The small white handles are the other joints. Click a handle to show a rotation ring, which rotates the segment going outward from that joint. Drag empty space to rotate the view.

点一下就套到现在这个角色身上，并且落到地面；不满意接着拖圆点改。这些姿势取自 Q: Click a pose to apply it to the current character and drop it to the ground; if you're not happy with it, keep dragging handles to adjust. These poses come from Quaternius's Universal Animation Library (CC0) and were made for ordinary humanoids: the fingers are posed too (gripping, spread, relaxed). When the arms would end up inside the body after applying (common with wide hips or large breasts), they are pushed outward a little around the shoulders. For arms gathered at the shoulders: if the pose is close to hanging down, they all move together (still fanned out); if it differs a lot, only the arm whose direction is closest moves. Other extra arms copy the same motion as the original arm (stacked rows stay offset from each other; with several upper bodies, each upper body does a full set of its own) and step aside when they hit the body or other arms; any that can't step aside keep their rest shape. Tails and wings keep their rest shape.
